wholePhysicalScope: The existing two-storey Hung Lau in the February 2017 description, including the southeast verandah and attached two-storey rear kitchen and storeroom.
lodDetails: The main house, southeast verandah and rear annex survive all four levels. Near views add door and window frames, stairs and pierced balcony blocks.
limitations: The exterior follows the February 2017 heritage description and the twelve-point mapped outline. The map controls the house, verandah and rear projections.
Floor levels, roof pitch, window spacing, screen-block pattern and color are approximate interpretations of the written evidence.
The steep natural grade remains in its original source grid. Thresholds, footings and the short approach stairs use modeled elevations.
The reconstruction covers the standing house, verandah and attached service annex. The surrounding former farm is represented by the original terrain.
